title: Image intake and downscaling
acceptance: Given a pasted, dropped or uploaded image, then it is scaled so the longest side is at most 1568 px and encoded as JPEG.
evidence: PR 1: sizing and data URL tests.

title: Vision requests
status: Implemented, not verified end to end
acceptance: Given Anthropic or OpenAI, then the image is encoded in that provider's format and sent directly from the browser.
evidence: PR 1: request body tests; in Chrome a mocked Anthropic call received a JPEG image block. Not run against a real provider.

title: Structured report
acceptance: Given a model reply, then the error, stack, explanation, ranked causes, fixes and searches are parsed and clamped; unusable replies are rejected.

title: Error region highlight
acceptance: Given a region as fractions of the image, then it is validated and clamped and drawn over the screenshot.
evidence: PR 2: region tests; in Chrome the outline matched the error line in the sample.

title: Local history
acceptance: Given results, then the last six are kept on this device with thumbnails, deduplicated by error, and can be reopened, removed or cleared.
evidence: PR 2: history tests; reopening verified in Chrome.

title: Demo mode
acceptance: Given demo mode, then a generated sample screenshot and a prepared report work with no key and no network.
evidence: manual: PR 1, full flow in Chrome.

title: Settings persistence
acceptance: Given a saved provider, when the page is reloaded, then the same provider is restored and is not overwritten by defaults.
Given a provider key, then it is kept in sessionStorage for the tab by default, kept on the device (localStorage) only when the user ticks "Remember on this device", and removable with "Clear key".
evidence: manual: fixed a reload bug and verified persistence and handled 401 responses from both providers in Chrome.

title: Stale analysis is ignored
acceptance: Given an analysis in flight, when the user discards the screenshot or loads another one, then the late result is ignored: it is not shown and not added to the history.
evidence: manual: in Chrome, discarding the screenshot during a demo analysis leaves the landing page with no tiles and no history entry (QA BUG-001).

title: Content Security Policy on the static export
acceptance: Given the Pages export, then every page carries a Content-Security-Policy meta tag that allows scripts only from the site and from the hashes of its inline scripts, and connections only to the site, api.anthropic.com and api.openai.com.
evidence: Hash and policy tests; published site checked in Chrome after deploy (SEC-001).
